verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents an Agents framework where you create multiple custom assistants in the Agent Builder, each powered by different model providers with its own files and avatar. Conversations are routed to an agent by picking it from the endpoint menu or @-mentioning it in chat, and subagents and an Agent Management API add more orchestration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-agent system prompts, isolated per-agent workspaces, channel-level routing or binding of external channels to agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
